name: Toes to bar
description: Toes to bar is raising the legs while hanging from a bar. Hang from the bar, raise the legs until the toes touch the bar, then lower back down.

items.content: Hands on the bar, scapulae depressed

stages.name: Eccentric
stages.description: Dead hang from the bar, arms straight, legs straight and together.

stages.name: Concentric
stages.description: Toes touching the bar, legs straight and together, arms straight.
